Web Push Countly Implementation




What the SDK does on its own: once push_vapid_public_key is set, every load re-registers the subscription token if the browser has already granted notification permission, and notification clicks are recorded as [CLY]_push_action without any code here. The button below is only needed for the very first opt-in, because browsers refuse a permission prompt that does not come from a user gesture. Pass push_auto_register: false to turn the automatic part off.

How to test: Serve this repo over HTTPS, or over HTTP from localhost, so the /countly_sw.js path is reachable from the page. Service workers and the Push API need a secure context: file:// and plain-HTTP LAN or hosted origins are both refused, only loopback is exempt. Replace app_key, url and push_vapid_public_key above. Click "Enable Push Notifications" and accept the browser prompt — the SDK will queue a token_session request containing the web_token JSON. To simulate a click-through, open DevTools → Application → Service Workers and use the "Push" button to inject a payload such as {"title":"Hi","message":"Test","c":{"i":"abc123"}}.
